# Jobzshala

> AI-native workforce infrastructure for the GCC. Jobzshala connects verified
> blue-collar and technical workforce with employers across the UAE, Saudi
> Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait and Bahrain, and runs the full journey from
> sourcing through visa, deployment and retention.

Jobzshala operates two audiences on one platform:

- **Candidates** create a verified workforce profile, upload documents, and are
  screened by recruiters before being matched to GCC openings. Onboarding is
  mobile-first and available over WhatsApp.
- **Employers** post roles, review recruiter-verified candidates, run interviews
  and offers, and track visa, medical, travel and joining operations.

What distinguishes the platform: every candidate is recruiter-verified before
activation, employers never see raw candidate contact details, and AI-assisted
matching recommendations are reviewed by a recruiter before reaching an employer.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://jobzshala.ae/): what the platform does, how hiring works, industries served.
- [Pricing](https://jobzshala.ae/pricing): plans for candidates and for employers.
- [Register](https://jobzshala.ae/register): create a GCC workforce profile.
- [Employer portal](https://jobzshala.ae/hire): employer sign-up and hiring dashboard.
- [Success stories](https://jobzshala.ae/success-stories): placement outcomes.
- [Blog](https://jobzshala.ae/blog): GCC hiring, workforce mobility and compliance writing.

## Notes for crawlers

Authenticated areas (`/dashboard`), the admin console (`/admin`) and the API
(`/api`, `/api-docs`) are not indexable and hold no public content.
Machine-readable structured data (Organization, WebSite, Service, BlogPosting,
OfferCatalog) is embedded as JSON-LD on the corresponding pages.
